title: How Memorizing One Verse a Week Changes What a Godly Man Does Under Pressure
caption:
When the pressure hits, you don't reach for the verse you meant to look up. You reach for whatever you've actually stored.

One verse a week. Pick the one aimed at the fight you're in. Say it in the minutes you already waste. Watch it show up before your temper does. Run the whole stack every Sunday.

"I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you." Psalm 119:11

Save this and pick this week's verse tonight.

#faith #godlyman #scripture #biblememory #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
